morphology_as_written: did not exhibit well-defined morphology, but existed in form of heterogeneous agglomerates with atypical cuboctahedron structure ... no significant differences were observed in particle size and degree of agglomeration
mechanism_as_written: HBr increases nucleation rate strongly but barely slows growth; at this high precursor concentration (0.2 M, the solubility limit in DMF) cluster-missing defects come from kinetic regulation rather than equilibrium ligand competition.
notes: regime 'kinetic' reflects the authors' statement about defect formation, not a time series of shape. 4 mmol ZrCl4 + 4 mmol H2BDC in 20 mL DMF, 50 mL Teflon autoclave. Without modulator only a trace of UiO-66 forms (RME 18.21%). The paper also made 1-9 eq. HF and HCl samples; SEM shapes for those are not described in the text.
